candidates.heuristic_context: Target problem types: errors and delays caused by inconsistent information exchange with customers or external partners. Applicable when information is repeatedly corrected, clarified or re-entered due to inconsistent formats or interfaces.
candidates.additional_context: 'O_Sent (online only)' occurs in 1800 cases, and in 66% of them the case afterwards REDOES work it had already completed — on average 1.92 distinct earlier activities, most often ['A_Validating', 'O_Returned', 'A_Incomplete']. That is the log signature of information arriving wrong, and it is what separates this from Contact Reduction (where the step merely repeats itself). The case then idles 99.24 h. Standardising the exchange lowers the correction rate at gateway node_41cf518 from 25% to 9%. ⚠️ The idle wait is WALL-CLOCK and the mined model has no construct for it, so 65.392 h/case is an ESTIMATE from the log reported beside the measurement, never added to it.
